summary: ABK Real Estate has a working property search and active listings. The site leaks leads: the contact links are placeholders and there is no WhatsApp, which is how Qatar property buyers prefer to ask.

findings.problem: The footer email link points to contact@mysite.com and the footer phone link to tel:123-456-7890. Both are template placeholders, while the visible text shows your real details.
findings.cost: A buyer who taps the email or phone link reaches nobody, and you lose a lead you paid to attract.
findings.fix: Correct, tested links across the whole site.

findings.problem: There is no WhatsApp button anywhere. The enquiry forms show no visible labels or privacy note, and Inqiure Now is a typo.
findings.cost: Property buyers in Doha message on WhatsApp first. Without it, they message the next agency.
findings.fix: WhatsApp on every listing, plus a clear enquiry form with a confirmation message.

findings.problem: No testimonials, agent profiles or licence number appear, and the News and several popup links go to #.
findings.cost: Buyers and landlords trust agents they can see. Anonymous agencies lose the listing to a named competitor.
findings.fix: Agent profiles, client reviews and your licence number on the homepage.

findings.problem: Typos and repeats: Commmercial, AlMuraikh, duplicate locations such as Wukair and Wakair, listing text cut off mid sentence, and the same featured listings shown twice.
findings.cost: Unfinished listings and typos make the agency look careless to a buyer comparing agencies.
findings.fix: Clean, proofread listings and one consistent location list.

redesign: A lead first homepage: property search, WhatsApp on every listing and a clear enquiry form.
Agent profiles, client reviews and licence details that make buyers trust you before the first call.
Area pages written to rank for searches like apartments for rent in Al Sadd Doha.
